verdict.rationale: Zep's core product is documented as a cloud service (the quick start installs `zep-cloud`). The pricing page lists 'Your VPC' as a deployment option, but no self-hosting docs or setup details back it up. What you can run yourself is Graphiti, the open-source temporal knowledge-graph framework underneath Zep. It works locally and has an MCP server, but it covers only part of the full Zep platform. Missing for 10: documented self-hosting of the full Zep platform, VPC deployment docs and requirements, an indication of whether VPC is enterprise-only, and independent hands-on reports of self-hosting.
